channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iranians fear more civilian infrastructure could be targeted in new US war
item.description: Energy facilities, industrial units, ports and bridges, schools, hospitals and apartment buildings have already been hit

item.title: Is the US-Israel war on Iran turning into a ‘frozen conflict’?
item.description: Trump says Washington doesn't need a deal with Tehran, while Iran rejects 'no war, no peace'. Is the war at an impasse?

item.title: Vessels on fire after naval mine hit in Hormuz Strait, Iran says
item.description: Two vessels have caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Palestinian woman, 72, shot dead by Israeli settlers in West Bank, health ministry says
item.description: Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fired after being attacked.
